elements.text: Salt Lake City International Airport’s susceptibility to convective, mountain-wave, and additional wind-related hazards
Enhancement of current wind detection capabilities at Salt Lake City International Airport to improve tower controllers’ awareness
Enhancement of wind sensing capabilities at other 14 CFR Part 139 airports susceptible to mountain wave and convective-related wind hazards
Installation of a low-level wind shear alerting system-network expansion at Salt Lake City International Airport
Addition of appropriate number of wind sensors based on land area coverage and terrain features to detect and warn of microburst activity
Ensuring all Title 14 CFR Part 139 airports have sufficient wind detection capabilities to warn of windshear and microburst activity in real time
